description: Election Commission - Declare that A. W. W. Thokhila was Selected as the member of Hikkaduwa Urban Council
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government council (Hikkaduwa Urban Council) due to the death of a member, following procedures outlined in the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the nomination and declaration of a new elected member to fill the electoral vacancy, which falls under electoral processes and related matters.
